scope: Rapid quality-gated manuscript abstraction, separate from historical mappings not reapproved by this run.
qualification: Food composition supports delivery, not intervention equivalence. This is not a clinically validated BRAIN Diet or ADHD treatment.

practices.pm_mission: Shape the rate of post-meal glucose appearance so metabolic and neuroendocrine systems face manageable, predictable load.
practices.input: Fish before rice in the studied meal sequence
practices.biological_role: Fish first delayed gastric emptying, an upstream control of carbohydrate delivery.
practices.limitation: An acute meal result; no claim that protein alone accounts for the effect.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Fish-before-rice comparison measured breath-test emptying and post-meal glucose responses.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Acute exploratory small study; meat comparison not the randomized crossover; no generic protein-first or chronic brain claim.

practices.exposure_qualification: An acute meal result; no claim that protein alone accounts for the effect.

practices.pm_mission: Shape the rate of post-meal glucose appearance so metabolic and neuroendocrine systems face manageable, predictable load.
practices.input: The tested beta-glucan addition to a polenta meal
practices.biological_role: The studied 5 g beta-glucan addition redistributed exogenous glucose appearance from the first two hours to later in the six-hour period.
practices.limitation: Twelve overweight adults; no lower overall appearing quantity and no universal fibre effect. Viscosity is a proposed explanation, not a measured mediator.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: The tested beta-glucan/polenta meal redistributed isotope-estimated glucose appearance.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Specific 5-g addition in twelve overweight participants; no decrease in total appearance and no universal whole-oat equivalence.

practices.exposure_qualification: Twelve overweight adults; no lower overall appearing quantity and no universal fibre effect. Viscosity is a proposed explanation, not a measured mediator.

practices.pm_mission: Limit glycaemic volatility so post-prandial glucose swings do not create unnecessary metabolic and neuroendocrine stress.
practices.biological_role: In adults with type 2 diabetes, the tested less-processed whole-grain package reduced daily glucose standard deviation and mean amplitude of glycaemic excursions (MAGE) versus a nutrient-matched finely processed package over two weeks.
practices.limitation: A food package, not an isolated grain or fibre effect; unmasked foods, short duration. Concealed randomisation, blinded CGM, initial masked analysis and intention-to-treat models support appraisal.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Less-processed whole-grain package reduced CGM excursions and variability relative to finely milled nutrient-matched grains.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: 31 enrolled, 28 completed; two weeks; type 2 diabetes; combined oats/rice/bread package. Not an isolated fibre effect or brain outcome.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary paper abstract/results and existing source assessment compared; full methods where accessible.

practices.exposure_qualification: The less-milled whole-grain package is the exposure; not a biochemical dietary requirement or equivalent to adding isolated fibre.

practices.pm_mission: Limit glycaemic volatility so post-prandial glucose swings do not create unnecessary metabolic and neuroendocrine stress.
practices.input: Early eating with front-loaded calories (six-day trial)
practices.biological_role: In a small prediabetes crossover, the tested early, front-loaded eating schedule reduced mean amplitude of glycaemic excursions (MAGE) over six days versus later calorie distribution; mean glucose and several other variability/range measures were inconclusive.
practices.limitation: Small sample, no washout; timing, eating-window length and calorie distribution cannot be separated.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Six-day early eating with front-loaded calories reduced MAGE and hyperglycaemic exposure in ten adults with prediabetes.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Timing, window and calorie distribution were combined. Inflammatory markers and OGTT did not improve; short trial does not establish universal timing benefits.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary paper abstract/results and existing source assessment compared; full methods where accessible.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Early time restriction added to calorie restriction did not improve average glucose or insulin-sensitivity measures over calorie restriction alone.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: Different 12-week protocol and overweight/obese population; incomplete CGM coverage. Retained as contrary context, not a second independent replication of Bruno.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary paper abstract/results and existing source assessment compared; full methods where accessible.

practices.exposure_qualification: Candidate early/front-loaded eating strategy in dysglycaemia; no universally optimal window or established brain/ADHD benefit. Longer trial with a different protocol was null.

practices.pm_mission: Limit glycaemic volatility so post-prandial glucose swings do not create unnecessary metabolic and neuroendocrine stress.
practices.biological_role: Two weeks of the tested supervised interval-walking programme reduced mean amplitude of glycaemic excursions (MAGE) versus an inactive control period in a small type 2 diabetes crossover trial.
practices.limitation: Small unmasked trial, baseline imbalance and missing sensor record; oxidative-stress markers did not improve. No blanket superiority to all continuous exercise.

mechanistic_evidence.proposition: Two weeks of supervised interval walking reduced CGM MAGE versus the control period in type 2 diabetes.
mechanistic_evidence.limitation: 14 participants, 13 usable CGM; mean glucose within-period inconclusive; oxidative stress unchanged. Not generic walking-dose or brain-effect evidence.
mechanistic_evidence.retrieval: Primary paper abstract/results and existing source assessment compared; full methods where accessible.

practices.exposure_qualification: Tested supervised slow/fast treadmill programme; retain population, intensity and null oxidative-stress findings.
